_about: One per signer operator (7). signatario.py + vigia.py sign. Values marked TBD-owner come from the owner's decisions and the deployment records (docs/BUSDC-MAINNET-V2.md). Paths follow the follower-rpc package (install.sh). Round 17, Arbitrum One: one signer daemon per network, with its own files, feed and source node. The keys from `anchor_policy` down are this network's (tools/evm-nets/networks.json); vigia.py takes the anchor keys by chain id and refuses a file that contradicts them.
l2_rpc: TBD-owner (an L2 RPC for mint pre-checks at latest; release never trusts it)
token: TBD-owner (bUSDC.arb address on the L2, from its deployment record)
token_from_block: TBD-owner (L2 deployment block from the same record)
source_vault: TBD-owner (the Arbitrum One vault: vault_pontes.py verify, busdcEthereum.vault)
vault_from_block: TBD-owner (Arbitrum One block of the vault deployment)
eth_signer: TBD-owner (this operator's release address, one of the vault's 7 signers)
eth_rpc: TBD-owner (this operator's own Arbitrum One node)

feed._about: docs/SIG-TRANSPORT.md. shared_dir is private to this operator. publish_dir is what bloch-busdc-arbitrum-one-feed.service serves, world-readable.
peers: TBD-owner (the other six operators' feeds, http://IP:8787; decided in docs/SIG-TRANSPORT.md)
mint_signers: TBD-owner (the token's 7 signers, checked against isSigner at start)
release_signers: TBD-owner (the vault's 7 signers, checked against isSigner at start)

_about_pacing: window 200 x 12 s = 2,400 s (Ethereum block numbers): the Ethereum bridge pacing and budgets fit unchanged. Run `vigia.py sign` without --interval (the network's 60 s is the default; a longer one is refused).
_about_timing: Review R329-EVM-4. The join window is 2400 s. Every release signature is timed into timing_state; `release-window-budget` is alerted at 480 s of work or anchor age per signature and the signer starts no round while its recent work exceeds 1200 s (`release-window-hold`). Watch the file with tools/evm-nets/signer_timing.py check.
